name: Status Trio
use_label: One menu bar icon for three signals
one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app that merges Wi-Fi, battery and volume into a single icon.

text.why: The menu bar is always short on space. Taking its cue from the iPhone's combined Wi-Fi, battery and cellular indicator, this puts three signals into one icon — with volume in place of cellular data.
text.take: It does one thing, which makes the decision easy: if your menu bar is crowded the effect is immediate, and if it is not, you do not need this.
build: A native macOS app in Swift under Apache-2.0. Icon size is configurable from 16 to 36 pt (28 pt by default), and you can opt to show the standard Wi-Fi icon for Ethernet.

who.role: Mac users with a crowded menu bar, especially on smaller laptop screens.

start.text: Download it from statustrio.lingai.net, install, and set the icon size once to suit your screen.

caveat: macOS only, and the author states plainly that it is an independent project with no Apple affiliation.

license.scope_text: Commercial use, redistribution OK. Keep notices; mark changes.

numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
